notes: Breadboard port names use the catalogue scheme '<row number><bank>.<column letter>'; the picture's rows 23 and 25 map to the numeric part and the letters A-E / F-J to banks t / b.
The pushbutton straddles the centre gap: side 1 on row 23 (E and F), side 2 on row 25 (E and F), as shown by the green highlighted rows.
Black wire goes from the Arduino digital-header GND to A23; yellow wire goes from pin 2 to A25. The GND header pin is assumed to be GND.2 (the catalogue has GND.1-3 and the image doesn't say which).
No resistor is used; pin 2 uses the internal pull-up (INPUT_PULLUP). Pin 13's built-in LED needs no external part.
Wire legs of the pushbutton are mapped to the 1.l/1.r and 2.l/2.r port names arbitrarily, since the pairs are symmetric.
